title.en: US Commerce Dept Approves Broad Launch of GPT-5.6 After Government Security Review
title.zhHans: 美国商务部批准 GPT-5.6 广泛发布，政府安全审查完成

searchSummary.en: The U.S. Department of Commerce approved OpenAI's GPT-5.6 for broad release on July 8, 2026, after additional testing under the new frontier AI oversight framework — ending the restricted-access period that began June 26.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026年7月8日，美国商务部批准 OpenAI 广泛发布 GPT-5.6，此前该模型在新前沿 AI 监管框架下完成了额外政府测试——结束了自 6 月 26 日开始的受限访问期。

summary.en: On July 8, 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce approved a broad launch of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 model following additional testing under Washington's new frontier AI oversight framework. The testing was conducted by the Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation, with OpenAI sending technical experts to Washington to address questions. OpenAI expects to release GPT-5.6 widely this week. The approval marks the first full test of the voluntary pre-release framework established by Trump's June 2 executive order, after OpenAI and Anthropic both faced government-mandated restrictions on their most advanced models.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月8日，美国商务部批准 OpenAI 广泛发布 GPT-5.6 模型，此前该模型在华盛顿新的前沿 AI 监管框架下完成了额外测试。测试由商务部的 AI 标准与创新中心进行，OpenAI 派遣技术专家到华盛顿回答问题。OpenAI 预计本周内广泛发布 GPT-5.6。此次批准标志着特朗普 6 月 2 日行政令建立的自愿预发布框架的首次全面测试，此前 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的最先进模型均面临政府强制限制。

narrative.en: On June 26, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) with restricted access — limited to approximately 20 government-approved partners at the White House's request. The restriction was the first exercise of the new frontier AI oversight framework established by Trump's June 2 executive order. For two weeks, the model's capabilities were locked behind government-mandated guardrails while the Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation conducted additional security testing. OpenAI sent technical experts to Washington to facilitate the review. On July 8, the Commerce Department gave final approval for broad launch. The approval signals that the new voluntary framework is operational: the government tested a frontier model, identified no unacceptable risks, and cleared it for wide release. The process sets a precedent for future model releases under the Trump administration's AI governance approach — a lighter-touch, voluntary review system distinct from the EU's mandatory compliance framework.
narrative.zhHans: 2026年6月26日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5.6（Sol/Terra/Luna），但在白宫要求下仅限约 20 个政府批准的合作伙伴访问。这一限制是特朗普 6 月 2 日行政令建立的新前沿 AI 监管框架的首次运用。在两周时间里，该模型的能力被锁定在政府强制的护栏之后，商务部的 AI 标准与创新中心进行了额外的安全测试。OpenAI 派遣技术专家到华盛顿协助审查。7月8日，商务部最终批准广泛发布。此次批准表明新的自愿框架已经运作：政府测试了一个前沿模型，未发现不可接受的风险，批准其广泛发布。这一过程为特朗普政府 AI 治理方法下的未来模型发布设立了先例——一种比欧盟强制合规框架更轻量的自愿审查制度。

description.en: First full test of the U.S. government's voluntary frontier AI pre-release framework. Sets precedent for how future advanced model releases will be handled — a lighter-touch alternative to EU-style mandatory compliance.
description.zhHans: 美国政府自愿前沿 AI 预发布框架的首次全面测试。为未来高级模型发布的处理方式设立了先例——一种比欧盟式强制合规更轻量的替代方案。

description.en: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna become available to the general public and developers, ending a two-week period where only ~20 government-vetted partners had access.
description.zhHans: GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna 向公众和开发者开放，结束了仅约 20 个政府审核合作伙伴拥有访问权限的两周限制期。

description.en: Concerns remain about the voluntary nature of the framework — critics argue that without mandatory compliance requirements, dangerous capabilities could still be released prematurely if companies choose not to participate.
description.zhHans: 对该框架的自愿性质仍有担忧——批评者认为，如果没有强制合规要求，若公司选择不参与，危险能力仍可能被过早释放。

text.en: The U.S. Department of Commerce approved broad launch of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 on July 8, 2026, after testing by the Center for AI Standards and Innovation.
text.zhHans: 美国商务部于2026年7月8日批准 OpenAI 广泛发布 GPT-5.6，此前 AI 标准与创新中心进行了测试。

text.en: The model was initially restricted on June 26 at the U.S. government's request, limiting access to ~20 government-approved partners.
text.zhHans: 该模型于6月26日应美国政府要求受限，仅限约20个政府批准的合作伙伴访问。

text.en: On August 6, 2026, OpenAI updated GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT for factual reliability and expanded GPT-5.6 Luna as the default model for Free users with unlimited text chats.
text.zhHans: 2026年8月6日，OpenAI 更新了 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-5.6 Sol 以提高事实可靠性，并将 GPT-5.6 Luna 设为免费用户的默认模型（支持无限文本对话）。
